doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Learning guitar from his mother
summary: Shade took lessons from his mother, who played guitar, and talks briefly about playing with picks.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Well, when you got started, did you take any lessons or did you pick up the guitar?
I took lessons from my mother.
Uh-huh. She played too? She played. Where did she play? What kind of numbers? Special numbers. Do you remember the names of any of them?
Come over here, the table is spreading, the rocks of Asia, and so forth like that.
I see. I see. Now, uh, did you ever play with picks?
Very similar to my play with picks, just some time. Uh-huh.
